reviews.reviewText:
Paper had a mix of easy and difficult questions. MCQs covered every chapter (Cuisine, Dresses pattern, Opioid example, Migration).
Short Questions:
1. Define population.
2. 3 characteristics of social institution.
3. Industrial sector role in Pakistan economy and its effect on social economy.
Long Questions:
1. Name 5 Punjabi sweets and desserts.
2. 5 importance of education.
3. Causes of poverty.
Note: Avoid highlighted handouts and past files; read full handouts.
